Attach verbose = TRUE result txt file. 
I need help. i hope so use r-inla and see result.

                         tag = 'est')

formulae <- y ~ 0 + sido +f(idx, model=spde, group=idx.group, control.group = list(model ='ar1'))


res <- inla(formulae, data = inla.stack.data(stack_data),
            control.predictor = list(compute=TRUE, A = inla.stack.A(stack_data)))

'''
